_rates_note: sample_rate stays 122.88e6: it is the RX rate AND the device tick, and every slot/frame count below is in those ticks. The TX stream runs at tx_sample_rate; every TX waveform is generated at 122.88 and x2 interpolated at the radio boundary (include/dsp/band_filters.h). DAC 5898.24 / interpolation 24, ADC 4915.2 / decimation 40.
_frequency_note: Sub-6 only: one NCO, 2425 MHz, on every channel (zone 1, cal Mode 1, RX filter on, all derived).
_gain_note: Written explicitly on every opened channel: make() now resets RX DSA to 0 dB and TX VOP to 20 mA. TX 0 dB = maximum VOP, where the software lane measured linearity (W2). The ue_*_gain_* fields below are Iris units and inert on Houdini.
_beacon_note: nr_pss_bl: the band-limited beacon (AP-79): the 127-tone NR PSS at 240 kHz (512-point, +-15.2 MHz) behind NR's 36-sample CP, then a guarded TRS pair on the central 96 tones of a 256-point symbol (+-23 MHz); 1076 ticks, inside the replay RAM at TX 245.76. The argmax pick: the shipped first_path rule lands 2 samples early on this lobe, which is about 8 samples wide (beacon_bandlimit_test).
_carried_note: tx_advance and corr_scale carried from the last demo; RE-MEASURE at mode V. ue_pilot_horizon 96 frames x 1 ms = 96 ms of lead, as before.
_comment: AP-79 ladder rung R1: mode-V converter clocks, TX 245.76 through the x2 interpolator, sub-6 ONLY at NCO 2425, the band-limited beacon nr_pss_bl, and fft 256 inside the OLD slot structure (4096-tick slots, 30 = 1 ms frame). Proves the band plan, rates, filters and beacon before the numerology changes. Next rung: houdini-dualband-r2.json (adds X-band). Derived from houdini-dualband.json (R3, the target).
_numerology_note: fft 256 at 122.88 = 480 kHz subcarriers; cp 64; 12 symbols x 320 + zero prefix 128 + postfix 128 = 4096 ticks, the old slot, 30 slots = 1 ms. 96 data subcarriers = 46.08 MHz (+-23.04, inside the +-24 MHz filter). The 128-tick prefix/postfix covers the TX prefilter margins (23/22).
_schedule_note: B, G, P, U then guards over 30 x 4096-tick slots = 1 ms, the old frame.
